Common Inquiries

Consultation booking FAQ.

What occurs after I submit a consultation booking request?

This frontend prepares the request locally. A secure delivery service and verified provider workflow must be connected before response timing or appointment confirmation can be promised.

Is payment collected during this booking request?

No. This frontend does not collect payment. Any future payment step must identify the verified provider, confirmed service, amount, and secure payment processor.

How should I prepare for my Ayurvedic consultation?

Have a brief overview of your daily waking, eating, and sleeping hours, as well as a list of any current herbal products or prescribed medications. Avoid heavy meals immediately prior to your session.

Can I reschedule or cancel my requested window?

Yes. Once our coordinator reaches out, you may request alternate days or timing without penalty. We recommend providing at least 24 hours notice for any rescheduling.
